text:
maria: Heads-up — we got a surge of 429s from us-east-1 starting ~10:02. Spike correlates with sustained GPU saturation on p4 pools. SDKs are ingesting 429s and hammering retries.

kevin: saw this on grafana too. queued_requests jumped, queue_time median went from 40ms -> 1.2s. A bunch of 429s don't include Retry-After header (old admission control path).

ashok: are those 429s coming from the gateway or the runtime? I saw gateway rate-limit metrics up.

maria: gateway is returning 429 in two cases: (1) per-customer token rate limit (2) admission-control when capacity exhausted. The admission-control path was recently changed to be lighter-weight; looks like we dropped Retry-After propagation there.

laura: SDK team: we need to ensure clients implement exponential backoff + jitter and respect Retry-After when present. Also, can SDK read any queue headers we provide? We have room to add one.

sdk-bot: quick note: current SDK (1.2.x) will retry on 429 with fixed 500ms sleep up to 3 attempts. It doesn't look for Retry-After. We should bump to exponential with full jitter.

kevin: proposal: 1) runtime/gateway should always set Retry-After (seconds) OR 202 + queue-token flow. 2) add a soft header `X-Redwood-Queue-ETA` (ms) and `X-Redwood-Queue-Pos` for observability. Clients can use these to back off concurrency. 3) SDK default: respect Retry-After if present, otherwise use exp backoff with full jitter starting 200ms, cap 8s, 4 retries.

ashok: +1. Also we should add `X-Redwood-Overload` boolean to make it explicit when request is rejected due to capacity vs rate limit. That helps metric slicing.

maria: examples of headers we'll standardize on:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 2
X-Redwood-Queue-ETA: 1100
X-Redwood-Queue-Pos: 12
X-Redwood-Overload: true
X-RateLimit-Limit: 60
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
```

laura: good. SDK change checklist:
- respect Retry-After header
- fall back to exp backoff with full jitter: sleep = random_between(0, base * 2^attempt)
- surface queue ETA to callers (callback or in exception metadata)
- expose header-based circuit-breaker hook so product teams can adjust concurrency

maria: runtime/infra action items:
- revert admission-control change that dropped Retry-After (short-term)
- add X-Redwood-* headers (canary to us-east)
- add metric labels: rejection_reason (capacity|rate_limit|network)

kevin: ops: can we add a short-term client-side mitigation? maybe an envoy filter to return 503 with Retry-After if backend queue > threshold so clients see consistent header?

ashok: envoy change sounds risky in prod. Instead, we can patch the admission controller to add Retry-After immediately — small change.

laura: timeline? SDK release should target next week (1.3.0) with the new retry semantics. We should document behavior in release notes and add a short migration doc for anyone with custom retry behavior.

maria: cost note: we saw GPU utilization rise for 15 minutes, and queued requests multiplied token throughput. If we push more retries immediately, we risk spinning up dedicated pools (higher cost) or throttling other customers. We need throttling + visible Retry-After to avoid retry storms.

kevin: monitoring additions: alert if 429 rate > baseline*5 for 5m AND avg_queue_time > 500ms. Also dashboard for `x-redwood-queue-eta` distribution.

laura: SDK PRs: I'll open draft with backoff impl + header parsing. Requesting a runtime config flag `xrdw.sdk_hibernate_on_overload` for opt-in behavior during canary.

maria: canary plan: patch admission-control -> add headers in us-east only for 2h window, watch error budgets and SDK telemetry. If stable, roll to us-west and eu.

kevin: reminder: update support playbook: what to tell customers when they see 429s (respect Retry-After, reduce concurrency, try a different region if available). Add npm/pypi SDK note.

laura: will add sample snippet for recommended client backoff in the migration doc:
```
// pseudo
for attempt in 0..3:
  resp = post(...)
  if resp.status == 429 or resp.headers['X-Redwood-Overload'] == 'true':
    ra = resp.headers.get('Retry-After')
    if ra:
      sleep(int(ra) + random_jitter())
    else:
      sleep(random_between(0, base * 2**attempt))
    continue
  break
```

maria: thanks all — follow-ups: @laura open SDK draft, @ashok patch admission-control, @kevin add alerts/dashboards, I'll schedule the canary. Ping me if you need infra creds.

deploy-bot: deploy started: admission-control/patch-1763301120 -> us-east (canary)

kevin: watching metrics now :eyes:

laura: SDK draft created: https://internal.redwood.com/p/sdk-pr-871 :thumbsup:

maria: closing thread here; we'll reopen if canary shows regressions. :wave:
